x-changelog.summary: Map frontend 'private' field name to 'is_private' in column exports
x-changelog.description:
The export endpoint now correctly maps the frontend `private` field name (used in
CIColumnKeys) to the backend `is_private` column when building exports from table
column state. Previously, only the `is_private` key was recognised; the `private`
variant sent by the frontend was silently dropped, causing the column to be missing
from exports when the user had selected it in the data table.

This mapping is only active when the private coordination issues feature flag is
enabled for the project.

Additionally, export events are now tracked via analytics with the event key
`project.coordination_issues.coordination_issue_export.list_exported`.

x-changelog.summary: Support for custom column configuration from frontend table state
x-changelog.description:
A new optional `column_state` parameter allows the export endpoint to respect custom column configurations
from the frontend table state. This enables users to export coordination issues with their personalized
column visibility and ordering from the web interface.

The `column_state` parameter accepts an array of objects with field names that correspond to the frontend
table configuration. The export will include only the visible columns in the order specified by the user.

Features:
* Custom column visibility based on frontend table state
* Maintains user-defined column ordering in exports
* Automatic mapping between frontend field names and backend column names
* Falls back to configurable field sets or default columns when `column_state` is not provided
* Always includes non-configurable columns (issue_number, status, created_at) for data integrity

Example usage: `GET /coordination_issues/export` with `column_state: [{"field": "title"}, {"field": "assignee"}]`

x-changelog.summary: Sort by Created By company name and then by status and finally by issue number
x-changelog.description:
A new optional sort allows the index endpoint to sort by company name of the issue creator, then by status, and finally by issue number in descending order.

The status order will always be:

* `unblocked`
* `open`
* `ready_for_review`
* `blocked`
* `moved_to_observation`
* `closed`

To use the new sort, include the following query parameter: `?sort=company_then_status`

x-changelog.summary: Add Watchers column to CSV exports
x-changelog.description:
A new optional column allows the export endpoint to include watchers information in CSV exports.

The watchers column displays a comma-separated list of watcher names for each coordination issue.

To include watchers in the export, add 'watchers' to the column_state parameter.
